extra_vocab.en: a way of doing something or dealing with a problem
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡 this approach 指前面說明的做法，也就是用不同機構設計來迴避 Wonderland 專利。Boyd 用 confident in this approach 表示對公司的處理方式有把握。
extra_vocab.grammar_note: approach 當名詞時，後面接 to + 名詞或 V-ing（an approach to the problem / to solving it），這個 to 是介系詞，不用 for。

example.en: Both approaches have advantages, so we need more data.
example.zh: 兩種做法各有優點，所以我們需要更多資料。

example.en: He approaches every negotiation with careful preparation and clear goals.
example.zh: 他以周全的準備與明確的目標來面對每一場談判。

example.en: Several investors approached us after the product launch.
example.zh: 產品上市後，有幾位投資人來接洽我們。

example.en: The deadline is approaching, so please finish your reports today.
example.zh: 截止日快到了，所以請今天完成你們的報告。

example.en: The company is trying a new approach to customer service.
example.zh: 公司正在嘗試一種新的客戶服務做法。

example.en: We should take a careful approach with this large order.
example.zh: 面對這筆大訂單，我們應該採取謹慎的做法。

example.en: Her approach to solving problems saves us a lot of time.
example.zh: 她解決問題的方法為我們省下很多時間。

example.en: A different approach may be needed to meet the deadline.
example.zh: 要趕上截止日，可能需要不同的做法。

examples.en: We need a new way, not the same approach as last year.
examples.zh: 我們需要新的方式，而不是和去年相同的做法。

examples.en: This approach reduces both cost and production time.
examples.zh: 這個做法同時降低了成本與生產時間。

examples.en: Thank you for your suggestion; we will consider this approach.
examples.zh: 謝謝您的建議，我們會考慮這個做法。

examples.en: Our approach is simple: test early and fix problems fast.
examples.zh: 我們的做法很簡單：及早測試，快速解決問題。

confusable.diff: approve 是「核准、同意」，拼法和 approach 很像；approach 是「方法」或「接近」。

example.en: The board will approve the budget on Thursday.
example.zh: 董事會將在星期四核准預算。

similar.diff: method 指具體的方法或步驟；approach 偏向處理事情的整體思路與態度。

example.en: This method is faster than the one we used before.
example.zh: 這個方法比我們之前用的更快。

similar.diff: strategy 是為了達成長期目標而定的策略；approach 的範圍較小，可以只是一種做法。

example.en: Our marketing strategy focuses on online sales this year.
example.zh: 我們今年的行銷策略以線上銷售為主。

example.en: We found a simple solution to the delivery problem.
example.zh: 我們找到了一個解決配送問題的簡單方法。

example.en: The approval process takes about three working days.
example.zh: 核准流程大約需要三個工作天。

example.en: The manager liked our approach to the budget problem.
example.zh: 經理很喜歡我們處理預算問題的做法。

example.en: We will approach several suppliers about lower prices.
example.zh: 我們會向幾家供應商洽詢降價的事。

senses.en: a way of doing something or dealing with a problem

example.en: Our approach to hiring has changed over the past year.
example.zh: 我們的招聘方式在過去一年有所改變。

senses.en: a road or path that leads to a place
senses.distinguish: 後面接地點（the factory、the airport）、談到路線或交通時，指通往該處的路。

example.en: The approach to the factory is blocked by construction.
example.zh: 通往工廠的道路被施工封閉了。
